desc: The Breech Plug Master Maintenance Kit is a comprehensive set of precision tools engineered for modern in-line muzzleloaders. Designed to simplify breech plug removal and cleaning, this all-in-one kit is compatible with most brands, including CVA, Traditions and Knight. From the Breech Plug 4-in-1Scraper to specialized sockets and spanner wrenches, the tools are purpose-built to remove fouling, clean tapered surfaces and maintain hard-to-reach areas without removing the breech plug.
